title: PRD view screen: versions, Markdown/HTML export, appendix, regenerate
summary: The PRD tab now shows the latest PRD with linked trace codes and audit appendix, a Writing state (including the agent that closed the last ticket), every kept version, and Markdown or self-contained HTML downloads, plus Regenerate, feedback and Edit structure.

deferred.what: The shell has no current-project context, so the PRD, Map and Project tabs each show the project opened last; with two projects open a member can see one project's PRD or map while working in the other
deferred.why: Needs a shell-wide project context outside the screen seams
